scripts.lint: npm run lint -w order-api-nest && npm run lint -w order-console-next
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w order-api-nest -- tsc --noEmit && cd order-console-next && npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w order-api-nest && npm run test -w order-console-next
scripts.test:api: npm run test -w order-api-nest && npm run test:e2e:api
scripts.test:web: npm run test -w order-console-next && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.test:e2e:web: bash scripts/harness/with-api.sh npm run test:e2e -w order-console-next
